S9:24.text: And the waters held on aboue the earth an hundred fiſtie dayes.

S9:4.text: For yet a while, and after ſeauen dayes, I wil rayne vpon the earth fourtie dayes and fourtie nights: and I wil cleane deſtroy al ſubſtance, that I haue made, from the face of the earth.
